method: Static x86 direct-call analysis. For every call to a proven WGSERVER import thunk, record a bounded same-block pre-call instruction window, push count, and immediate post-call ADD ESP cleanup when present.
interpretation_limits: A bounded push count is not asserted to equal the formal parameter count.
No immediate ADD ESP does not by itself prove stdcall because cleanup can be delayed or shared.
Register arguments, hidden arguments, tail calls, indirect calls, and host-internal behavior remain outside this evidence.
